Selected FCM Financial Data as of December 31, 2025
Selected FCM Financial Data as of August 31, 2026
Ripple Offers Clients Access to Coinbase Derivatives Contracts Cleared by Nodal Clear

reporting_rules.monthly_reports: FCMs file monthly financial reports within 17 business days after month-end; selected information is published by CFTC.
reporting_rules.publication_lag: CFTC says the most recent month-end information is generally added within 12 business days after filing.
reporting_rules.amendments: CFTC states it does not revise the published data to reflect amended financial information subsequently received.

key_definitions.adjusted_net_capital: Regulatory capital measure reported by the FCM; not equivalent to cash, GAAP equity, AUM or XRP-specific capital.
key_definitions.excess_net_capital: Adjusted net capital less the firm's net capital requirement.
key_definitions.customer_assets_in_segregation: Money, securities and property held in segregated accounts for futures and options customers under CEA Section 4d(a)(2); customer property, not proprietary capital.
key_definitions.customer_seg_required: Amount the FCM is required to segregate for customers trading on a designated contract market.
key_definitions.excess_or_deficient_segregation: Customer assets in segregation less the customer segregation requirement.

ripple_prime_us_fcm.legal_name: Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC
ripple_prime_us_fcm.business_context: Primary U.S. regulated FCM/broker-dealer operating entity within Ripple Prime; ultimate parent changed to Ripple after the Hidden Road acquisition in October 2025.

coinbase_fcm.business_context: Coinbase's CFTC-registered FCM; separate from Coinbase National Trust Company, Coinbase Custody Trust Company and Coinbase Derivatives Exchange.

same_date_comparison_aug_2026.interpretation: Raw legal-entity regulatory measures only. These ratios do not establish superior credit quality, profitability, market share, risk management, or XRP exposure. Product mix and customer base differ.

relationship_graph.to: Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC

relationship_graph.from: Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC

xrp_specific_interpretation.confirmed: The March 5, 2026 Nodal Clear/Ripple announcement says Ripple Prime clients can access Coinbase Derivatives contracts, including XRP futures, through Nodal Clear.
not_established: Actual XRP futures open interest attributable to Ripple Prime clients
XRP-specific collateral held by either FCM
Actual XRP spot purchases by either FCM
Net directional exposure of Ripple Prime or Coinbase customers
Whether access produces net XRP demand rather than hedging or offsetting exposure
xrp_specific_interpretation.warning: Access to an XRP futures contract is not equivalent to buying spot XRP or holding XRP as collateral.

capital_context.recovered_original_phrase_context: Prior research context associates 'actual capital' with Ripple Prime/Hidden Road regulatory net capital, customer-segregated funds, repo financing and parent contributions. This CFTC dataset is the strongest current public monthly regulatory capital source found in this run.
capital_context.parent_contribution_link: A separate SEC audited statement reports $70m of capital contributions from the immediate Parent through 2026-02-26. The CFTC adjusted-net-capital increase from Dec 2025 to Aug 2026 is $449.822m; do not attribute the full increase to that $70m contribution.
distinctions: Adjusted net capital is not GAAP equity.
Customer-segregated assets are not proprietary capital.
Gross repo financing is not capital.
No XRP-specific exposure is disclosed in the CFTC FCM data.

unknowns: September and October 2026 FCM reports were not yet present on the CFTC index at retrieval.
The cause and composition of the $449.822m increase in Ripple Prime's adjusted net capital are not disclosed in the selected CFTC table.
No breakdown of customer assets by crypto asset, contract or XRP exposure is provided.
No customer concentration, revenue, profitability or margin-by-product data is provided.
Coinbase Financial Markets' cleared-swaps segregation is reported, but instrument-level XRP positions are not.
next_actions: Ingest the next CFTC monthly FCM report when posted and preserve each vintage because CFTC says it does not revise published datasets.
Reconcile the SEC audited December 2025 financial statement with CFTC monthly FCM data, noting that the year-end figures match numerically but the CFTC series labels the measure adjusted net capital.
Track Coinbase Financial Markets and Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC separately from their parent companies and trust-bank entities.
Monitor Nodal Clear/Coinbase Derivatives XRP futures open interest, volume, margin and clearing data; distinguish product access from realized customer utilization.
Do not infer spot XRP demand from FCM capital or futures access.
